title: March to the Death
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Full military band -- trumpets, piccolo, horns, tuba, timpani and field drums. Wanted for a war being won AND a war being lost catastrophically, which is two opposite valences and something no single signed point can express. "valenceMode": "magnitude" is the answer: the 0.85 above is matched against |valence|, so this asks for a DECISIVE war in either direction and stays out of the undecided middle, where Parade Uniform and Bombing Voronezh belong. Restricted to game -- a death march has no business on a title screen. Editable source: data/audio/midi/March to the Death.mid
